The host pointed to a segment in the president’s “60 Minutes” interview in which he was asked if he thought he was going to heaven.

“I hope so,” Trump replied. “I don’t want to go to hell.”

Fallon let the remark sink in for several seconds.

“America was like, ‘Then where have we been living the past three years?’” the comedian cracked.

Many Democrats found a slice of heaven in last week’s election results, in which Republicans lost the House and the Senate.

But the mention of a potential Trump journey into the depths of you-know-where was also on the mind of talk show counterpart Jimmy Kimmel.

“You are going to hell. You are gonna open your eyes and pray you’re watching ‘South Park,’” Kimmel added. “You will be in hell.”
